notes.zh: Mesh 与线框统一支持 ID 文件和 ID 文件夹，增加网格单个/多个 ID 与版本沿用；显示控制移至预览区，项目栏更简洁。保留旧项目组织与选择；提供同版本完整 APK。
notes.en: Unify ID-file and ID-folder imports across Mesh and Wireframe, with Mesh single/multiple IDs and remembered OBJ variants. Compact viewing controls preserve space for project files. Migrate existing project organization and selection; matching complete APK included.
